title: Giving Design Feedback That Gets You to the Final Version Sooner

facebook.message:
Sent your first logo concepts and not sure what to say?
Our latest guide shows how to give feedback a designer can act on:
• Judge each concept against your brief, not your first impression
• Describe what you notice and why, rather than prescribing the fix
• Collect everyone's views into one clear reply

To read the full article, visit the FinTaxTech website and find "Giving Design Feedback That Gets You to the Final Version Sooner" in our Blog section.
#BrandDesign #SmallBusiness

instagram.caption:
Vague feedback like "make it pop" is the quickest way to slow a design project down.
A few habits help a designer get you to the final version sooner:
→ Re-read your brief before you comment
→ Say what you notice and why it worries you
→ Offer ideas as suggestions, not instructions
→ Send one consolidated reply, not several
→ Match your comments to the stage of the project
